name: navigator-prompt-guidance
body: The distributed agent-prompt surface: `opencode-suite/agents/*.md`, embedded in the apg binary via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`. It is where the navigator's non-negotiable rules and the agent-builder's generation rules live, so it is the surface that carries the graph-first ordering and makes every generated agent inherit it. Included files: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (the ordering rule, plus the in-graph / outside-the-graph artifact-class boundary) and `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (rule 5, propagation to generated agents). With 0.17.0 the boundary text shrinks: the structural scanner puts the tracked text/config/packaging files in the graph, and the outside-the-graph class denotes files with zero symbols rather than files with zero nodes — Ruby (`Formula/*.rb`, pending `apg-ruby`) and binaries have zero frontend, so they land as residual `misc` `File` nodes carrying zero Module/Struct/Function facts, while the paths the config scope and the standard exclusions remove land with zero node at all.
